messages.text: BL-1757 🎵 in progress — A target's Telegram front desk and Cursor Remote bridge start from the tooling root's compiled tools - a pack conf may name the swarmforgevc checkout that serves it (config tooling_root <abs path>), swarmforge.sh exports it as SWARMFORGE_TOOLING_ROOT, and launch_front_desk.sh and start_cursor_bridge.sh resolve their node entrypoints there while still serving the target; a project with its own extension/out and no tooling root resolves exactly as today, and neither is refused naming both places looked
